title: M2S-Bench Protocol B route row
description: Participant-facing JSONL row for target-blind evidence purchase. Exactly one primary action is allowed. Current official menus leaderboard-score route, or ranked_views when route is absent; view_set and abstain are accepted only when a view/cost menu declares a non-oracle set or abstention rule. Menu membership, cost-menu consistency, and recursive forbidden-key checks are enforced by scripts/validate_protocol_b_route.py.

query_id.description: Opaque query id from the released manifest.

cell_id.description: Opaque cell or candidate-pool id from the released manifest.

tier.description: Visibility tier used by the solver.

cost_menu.description: Declared cost-menu/profile version, e.g. dense-semantic-v1-op, 2wiki-structured-v1-op, or 2wiki-hyper-v1-op.

route.description: Primary evidence view to buy. Must be declared in the view menu for this row. A null value is treated as absent by the validator.

ranked_views.description: Optional ranked diagnostic list. If route is absent, the evaluator uses the first valid entry as the primary route.

view_set.description: Optional set-valued diagnostic. It is valid as a primary action only when the menu declares a non-oracle set_rule; otherwise current official leaderboards reject it.

abstain.description: Optional abstention action. It is valid as a primary action only when the menu declares an abstain_rule or abstain_cost.

method.description: Optional method name for grouping public development runs.

runtime_s.description: Optional local runtime recorded by the runner.

diagnostics.description: Optional method-visible diagnostics. Must not contain evaluator-only qrels, support facts, labels, hidden targets, or unpaid CE/full scores.
